slide.typeUpToDateAutoSaved: {{type}} is up to date! Changes are auto-saved.

slide.renameUnsupported: This slide type can't be renamed here.

ui.splitScreenLoadingErrorBody: Failed to load the split screen component. This is usually a temporary issue.

integrity.imagesInTable: This slide has {{count}} image(s) inside a table, which the editor cannot open or keep. It was NOT {{action}}, so nothing is lost — your slide is safe as-is. To edit it, the image(s) must be moved out of the table first; please contact support.
integrity.incomplete: This slide did not load completely ({{missing}} missing). To protect your content it was NOT {{action}}. Please reload the page and try again.
